bias.en: Downtrend · lost $155, lowest close since June 2025
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 失守 $155，收盘创 2025年6月以来新低

read.en: Nvidia fell 2.9% on Nov 18 to $150.96, trading $150.40–159.70 on heavy volume (1.45x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($158.3), 10-day ($168.1), 30-day ($200.1), 200-day ($203.7) and 100-day ($211.1), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram little changed; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($165.76), and RSI is 21.1, deeply oversold.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月18日下跌 2.9%，收于 $150.96，盘中区间 $150.40–159.70，成交量放大（为 20 日均量的 1.45 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$158.3）、10 日（$168.1）、30 日（$200.1）、200 日（$203.7）和 100 日均线（$211.1）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图变化不大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$165.76），RSI 为 21.1，深度超卖。

read.en: The close broke the $155 support (Nov 16 low), now resistance, and is the lowest since June 2025. Resistance is $155–156.1 (Nov 16 low, Nov 16–17 closes), then $158.3–159.7 (5-day, Nov 18 high) and $162.9–163.2. Support is $150.3–150.4 (Nov 17–18 lows), then the $148.8 52-week low. A close above $156.1 would target $158–160; below $148.8 would set a new 52-week low.

r.en: Nov 16 low $155.01, lost; Nov 17 close $155.46; Nov 16 close $156.14
